parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:


- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **20**.
